Start reading1

Hasama Shin is a solo guy who loves being alone. He even changed jobs to enjoy his time alone after coming home, and one day, a girl living in the apartment next door asks him if he wants to hang out with her. "It's creepy that she asked me out on our first meeting, and more than anything, I don't have time for other people! ...Or so I thought, but I was tempted and ended up hanging out with her, and she started following me around every day...?!" A comedy about the struggle between a solo guy and a lonely girl!! (Source: YanMaga Web, translated)
